name: clayver-monorepo
description: Open-source customer support for mobile apps, running in your own Firebase project.

scripts.cli:link: turbo run build --filter=clayver && cd packages/setup && npm link
scripts.dev:setup: pnpm --filter clayver build:cli && node packages/setup/dist/cli.js dev setup
scripts.dev:deploy: pnpm --filter @clayver/functions rules:build && pnpm --filter clayver build:cli && node packages/setup/dist/cli.js dev deploy
scripts.dev:dashboard: pnpm --filter clayver build:cli && node packages/setup/dist/cli.js dev dashboard
